relations: Kayla 是 Vero 的女朋友：Vero 对演员说 “That’s my girlfriend, isn’t she beautiful?”；Kayla 自己则说 “That’s my man—or mine and Vero’s, but still.”，她同时是 Clay 的恋人
Vero 与 Brawley 是伴侣，Vero 逗他戴恶魔角并替他吹风：“He fought me on those for twenty minutes.” “But he is a sucker for a pout, just in case you ever need to persuade him of something.”
Ares 与 Kayla 关系升温：摩天轮上他 “reaches over and straightens my crown”，她想 “how much this man has come to mean to me”
Brawley 是团队里做大部分饭菜的人（“It’s normally Brawley since he makes most of the meals.”），与 Kayla 亲近，在海滩搂住她肩膀问 “Did you have a good time?”
Ares 说出岛上 “the hirer and firer on the island”，并戏称 “I’m sure Nix will appreciate that”，暗示 Ares 与 Nix 同属岛上管理层；Vero 与 Clay 是同住伙伴，Clay 抢着说 “He doesn’t work for you”
numbers: The first goes in, and then the second
the third shot goes in too

facts.fact: Vero 在厨房宣布今晚要带 Kayla 绕岛参加万圣节儿童活动，并被 Brawley 打断过话头
facts.anchor: “The jig is up,” Vero sighs out dramatically. “We are taking you around the island tonight. It’s a kids’ event for Halloween.”

facts.fact: Clay 走进厨房拒绝穿任何装扮，并与 Brawley、Vero 顶撞；Vero 递给他一个黑色面具，他收下但没戴上
facts.anchor: He stops when he sees us all staring at him and snaps, “I’m not wearing a stupid fucking costume.”

facts.fact: Kayla 上楼换上前一天在礼品店买的猫耳、黑牛仔裤、黑卫衣，并用化妆品画了黑鼻和胡须
facts.anchor: I leave them in the kitchen and run upstairs, grabbing the cat ears I got from the gift shop yesterday to wear at the bar for the nights I work, and put on a black pair of jeans and a black sweatshirt.

facts.fact: 在玉米地边，Cave 冻立不动吓住一个约十岁小孩，孩子尖叫跑开；Kayla 看到 Cave 唇边一闪而过的坏笑，Cave 向她点头，她也点头回应
facts.anchor: I see the shadow of a smirk on Cave’s lips before it vanishes. He nods at me, and I nod back before he steps back into the cornstalks and waits for more children to come past.

facts.fact: Clay 在水枪射击摊赢奖后走过来把一只黑猫毛绒玩具塞给 Kayla，一句话不说就走开
facts.anchor: Once he puts the pistol back down and collects his prize, Clay walks over to me and hands me a stuffed black cat, but he says nothing and keeps walking.

facts.fact: Kayla 在投篮摊连中三球，拿到一个泡沫小皇冠，回头发现四个男人都沉默地盯着她
facts.anchor: Once I collect my prize and my stuffed cat, I turn around to find all four of my men watching me in stunned silence.

facts.fact: 摩天轮上 Ares 替她扶正皇冠并肯定她 happiness，Kayla 承认自己现在被允许快乐，心里记下这个男人对她意味着什么
facts.anchor: He reaches over and straightens my crown. “Good.”

facts.fact: 惊魂迷宫里地板骤降灯光熄灭、有人用冰块碰她后颈，Kayla 抓住 Ares 的手臂尖叫；事后她对演员宣布 {L}You are fired.{R}，Clay 说演员不归她管，Ares 提到 Nix
facts.anchor: “I will take it up with the hirer and firer on the island.”
